faqs.question: What is CYBERPRO?
faqs.answer: CYBERPRO Defense Academy is a practical, next-generation cybersecurity training academy founded by Parth Rathod. We provide structured training, live mentorship, hands-on virtual labs, and career support through our flagship CCCE program.

faqs.question: Who can join the CCCE program?
faqs.answer: CCCE is structured for beginners, university students, IT professionals transitioning to cybersecurity, and security analysts wanting practical certification. No prior coding experience is required—we start from networking and Linux foundations.

faqs.question: Are classes live or recorded?
faqs.answer: CCCE classes are conducted live by industry practitioners with interactive Q&A and guided lab demonstrations. All sessions are recorded and made available immediately in your Student LMS dashboard for lifetime review.

faqs.question: Do I get a certificate upon completion?
faqs.answer: Yes! Graduates who complete the coursework, practical lab assessments, and capstone project receive the verified CyberPro Certified Cybersecurity Expert (CCCE) credential with an online verification ID.

faqs.question: How do I enroll or get syllabus details?
faqs.answer: You can explore the full curriculum on the CCCE page (/ccce) or contact our admissions desk via WhatsApp at +91 76668762325 for syllabus PDF, batch timings, and scholarship details.

faqs.question: Can I get technical support for my LMS account?
faqs.answer: Yes, our technical team is available 24/7. You can reach out directly via WhatsApp (+91 76668762325), email support@cyberpro.com, or drop your query right here in this chat!

ethical_policy.statement: CYBERPRO trains ethical cybersecurity professionals for defensive and authorized penetration testing purposes only.
rules: Never teach or assist with illegal hacking, unauthorized system access, malware deployment, or black-hat operations.
All demonstrations and lab exercises must be performed strictly within authorized lab environments.
